svg.text: Mockup 9 · the activity window, and the top right
Her face, and your session in lavender.
Filled: nothing else can start until it's through. Outlined: only waiting. Point at one for its line.
Pink, first in line: a signature is waiting in your wallet.
Sign the claim in your wallet
Pink fill, and a way to try again. It stays until you've seen it.
The trade failed: the price moved
Six fit; the rest are a count. Like kinds stack with a number.
Her face in the top strip; the icons in a line under it.
Each line names its thing (a link) and how long. Busy first.
Top right, way A: two pieces
Where you are up top; how you're looking over the dock.
Top right, way B: one panel
The name leads; the map and zoom fold out under it (and fold away).
A star, a black hole, or a pair: one button, one name.
